intro: India's Silicon Valley is a paradox of lush gardens and gridlocked traffic. Filming here requires mastering the monsoon humidity and navigating chaotic intersections.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park
attractions.tip: Shoot early morning (6 AM) to avoid crowds. Green canopy provides natural diffusion.

attractions.name: MG Road
attractions.tip: Use a gimbal for walking shots. Traffic is heavy; get permits for tripod use.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
attractions.tip: Glass house is iconic. Best light at golden hour through the trees.

weather: Moderate year-round. Heavy rains June-Sept. Carry rain covers.
airport: Kempegowda (BLR). 45 mins to city. Pre-book Uber/Ola.
permits: Required for commercial shoots in parks. Police verification needed for street interviews.

intro: A coastal powerhouse with deep cultural roots. The heat is intense, and salt air corrodes gear fast. Protection is key.

attractions.name: Marina Beach
attractions.tip: Second longest in world. Watch out for waves. Sunset shots are mandatory.

attractions.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
attractions.tip: No shoes. Shoot from outside walls if inside is restricted. Vibrant colors.

attractions.name: George Town
attractions.tip: Narrow streets. Use a wide lens. Bustling market energy.

weather: Very hot/humid. Oct-Dec is monsoon. Gear fogging is common.
airport: Chennai International (MAA). 30 mins to city. Taxis available.
permits: Strict rules near government buildings. Temple filming often restricted.

intro: Home to Charminar and massive tech parks. Contrast between historic darkness and modern brightness. Low light performance matters.

attractions.name: Charminar
attractions.tip: Night shots are best. Crowds are thick; use a monopod.

attractions.name: Golconda Fort
attractions.tip: Sound and light show is popular. Day shoot requires hiking up.

attractions.name: Ramoji Film City
attractions.tip: World's largest film studio. Permits easy to get for creators.

weather: Hot dry summers. Pleasant winters. Dust is a factor.
airport: Rajiv Gandhi (HYD). 45 mins to city. Metro connection planned.
permits: Historical sites require ASI permission. Film city has specific packages.

intro: A heritage city with stunning stepwells and strict alcohol laws. The sun is harsh; dynamic range is your friend.

attractions.name: Sabarmati Ashram
attractions.tip: Gandhi's home. Quiet zones enforced. No tripods inside rooms.

attractions.name: Adalaj Stepwell
attractions.tip: Incredible geometry. Shoot mid-day for shafts of light.

attractions.name: Old City (Manek Chowk)
attractions.tip: Night market is vibrant. Food shots work well here.

weather: Extremely hot Apr-Jun. Dry rest of year. Dust storms possible.
airport: Sardar Vallabhbhai (AMD). 30 mins to city. Cabs easy to find.
permits: Ashram has strict rules. Drone ban strictly enforced.

intro: A city of extreme contrasts. Skyscrapers loom over slums. Security is tight; blending in with a small camera is safer.

attractions.name: Intramuros
attractions.tip: Spanish walled city. Horse carriages make great B-roll. Permit needed for tripods.

attractions.name: Binondo (Chinatown)
attractions.tip: Oldest in world. Narrow alleys. Eat while shooting.

attractions.name: Makati Skyline
attractions.tip: Shoot from rooftop bars. Traffic below is chaotic but visual.

weather: Tropical. Wet season Jun-Oct. Sudden downpours common.
airport: NAIA. Close to city but traffic to exit is terrible. Allow 2 hours.
permits: Police often stop filming. Be polite, show ID. Drones strictly banned.

intro: The sinking capital. Massive traffic jams and sudden floods. Waterproof gear is non-negotiable.

attractions.name: Kota Tua
attractions.tip: Old town square. Colorful buildings. Very crowded weekends.

attractions.name: Monas (National Monument)
attractions.tip: Iconic spike. Park around it is vast. Good for hyperlapse.

attractions.name: Glodok
attractions.tip: Electronics district. Cyberpunk vibes. Low light challenges.

weather: Hot/humid year-round. Wet season Nov-Mar. Flash floods frequent.
airport: Soekarno-Hatta (CGK). Far from city (1hr+). Train is fastest option.
permits: Filming near government buildings risky. Local fixer recommended.

intro: The ultimate creator hub. Incredible street food and temples. But disrespecting the monarchy or Buddha images leads to arrest.

attractions.name: Grand Palace
attractions.tip: Strict dress code. No video inside main temples. Shoot exterior details.

attractions.name: Chatuchak Market
attractions.tip: Weekend only. Maze-like. Great for POV walking shots.

attractions.name: Chao Phraya River
attractions.tip: Take a long-tail boat. Golden hour on the water is magic.

weather: Extremely hot Mar-May. Rainy season Jul-Oct. AC is your refuge.
airport: Suvarnabhumi (BKK). Efficient train (ARL) to city. Avoid taxis in rush hour.
permits: Royal family images forbidden. Temple rules vary; ask guards first.

intro: Energy overload. Millions of motorbikes create a river of traffic. Crossing the street is an extreme sport.

attractions.name: Ben Thanh Market
attractions.tip: Chaotic inside. Better shots outside at night market.

attractions.name: War Remnants Museum
attractions.tip: Somber tone. No flash photography. Respectful behavior required.

attractions.name: Nguyen Hue Walking Street
attractions.tip: Wide boulevard. Perfect for timelapses of crowds.

weather: Hot year-round. Wet season May-Nov. Afternoon storms predictable.
airport: Tan Son Nhat (SGN). Very close to city. Grab bikes are fastest transport.
permits: Sensitive about war content. Police may delete footage if angry.

intro: Ancient wonders meet chaotic modernity. Constant negotiation with vendors and guards. Sand destroys sensors quickly.

attractions.name: Pyramids of Giza
attractions.tip: Go inside early. Camel rides require hard negotiation. Don't put camera down.

attractions.name: Khan el-Khalili
attractions.tip: Medieval market. Dense crowds. Watch your pockets.

attractions.name: Nile Corniche
attractions.tip: Sunset views. Felucca boats make great B-roll.

weather: Hot dry days, cool nights. Sandstorms (Khamsin) possible spring.
airport: Cairo Intl (CAI). Visa on arrival for many. 45 mins to Giza.
permits: Tripod permit mandatory for Pyramids. Police escort often required.

intro: Where Europe meets Asia. Stunning mosques and bazaars. Security is tight near bridges and squares.

attractions.name: Hagia Sophia
attractions.tip: Now a mosque again. Cover shoulders/knees. Prayer times restrict filming.

attractions.name: Grand Bazaar
attractions.tip: Massive labyrinth. Low light inside. Ask before filming shops.

attractions.name: Galata Bridge
attractions.tip: Fishermen line the sides. Sunset skyline shots are classic.

weather: Mediterranean. Rainy winters. Hot summers. Windy on the bridge.
airport: IST (New airport). Far from city (1hr). Havaist bus is reliable.
permits: Professional gear flagged at mosques. Drones heavily restricted.

intro: A misunderstood gem with incredible architecture. Filming rules are strict; women must wear hijab. Air quality varies.

attractions.name: Golestan Palace
attractions.tip: UNESCO site. Mirrors and tiles. Tripods allowed with permit.

attractions.name: Tajrish Bazaar
attractions.tip: Authentic local vibe. Less touristy than Grand Bazaar.

attractions.name: Milad Tower
attractions.tip: Modern skyline view. Best at night.

weather: Cold winters, hot dry summers. Pollution traps smog in winter.
airport: Imam Khomeini (IKA). Strict customs. Declare all gear.
permits: Visa required for most. Filming permit mandatory. Female dress code strict.

intro: Rapidly opening up. Modern skyscrapers next to old mud forts. Heat is unbearable mid-day. Conservative dress expected.

attractions.name: Diriyah
attractions.tip: Historic birthplace. Mud brick architecture. Night illuminations are great.

attractions.name: Kingdom Centre
attractions.tip: Sky bridge offers city views. Mall inside is luxurious.

attractions.name: Al Masmak Fortress
attractions.tip: Small fort in old town. Good for history segments.

weather: Scorching summer (50°C+). Pleasant winter. Sand common.
airport: King Khalid (RUH). New terminal. Uber/Careem widely available.
permits: Tourist visa easy now. Filming permits needed for gov buildings. Respect prayer times.

intro: Rebuilding slowly. High security presence. Checkpoints everywhere. A rugged action cam is best to stay low profile.

attractions.name: Al-Mustansiriya University
attractions.tip: Historic architecture. Ask permission before entering.

attractions.name: Tigris River
attractions.tip: Boat rides available. Sunset views of the city.

attractions.name: Mutanabi Street
attractions.tip: Booksellers street. Cultural heart. Busy Fridays.

weather: Extremely hot summer. Mild winter. Dust storms frequent.
airport: Baghdad Intl (BGW). High security. Escort sometimes required.
permits: Fixer essential. Military zones forbidden. Always carry passport.

intro: Grand scale and cold winters. Red Square is iconic but heavily guarded. Batteries die fast in winter.

attractions.name: Red Square
attractions.tip: No tripods without permit. Guards watch closely. Night shots clear of crowds.

attractions.name: Metro Stations
attractions.tip: Underground palaces. Chandeliers. Rush hour is insane.

attractions.name: Gorky Park
attractions.tip: Modern vibe. Winter ice skating. Summer cafes.

weather: Freezing winters (-20°C). Snowy. Summers mild. Keep batteries warm.
airport: Sheremetyevo/SVO. Aeroexpress train to city. Visa required for most.
permits: Kremlin filming banned. Metro filming restricted. Police strict on foreigners.

intro: The classic dream. Beautiful but crowded. Pickpockets target camera gear. Strict rules on tripods in public spaces.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.tip: Night lights are copyrighted (technically). Shoot from Trocadero.

attractions.name: Montmartre
attractions.tip: Artists square. Cobblestone streets. Watch bags.

attractions.name: Seine Riverbanks
attractions.tip: UNESCO site. Picnic shots popular. Drone ban strict.

weather: Mild. Rainy autumn. Grey winters. Golden hour in summer long.
airport: CDG/Orly. RER train to city. Strikes common; check schedules.
permits: Tripod permit needed for public spaces. Eiffel Tower night shot copyright issue.

intro: History meets modern finance. Unpredictable rain. Royal Parks have strict commercial filming rules.

attractions.name: Westminster
attractions.tip: Big Ben/Parliament. Crowded. Police monitor tripods.

attractions.name: Camden Market
attractions.tip: Alternative vibe. Narrow stalls. Great food shots.

attractions.name: South Bank
attractions.tip: Street performers. Thames views. Walk from Tate to Tower Bridge.

weather: Rainy year-round. Overcast. Rare heatwaves. Waterproof gear essential.
airport: Heathrow/Gatwick. Express trains expensive. Tube is cheaper.
permits: Royal Parks need permit. TFL (Tube) filming requires approval.

intro: Vibrant music capital. Power is unreliable. Phone filmmaking is practical and less threatening than big cameras.

attractions.name: Congo River
attractions.tip: Massive river. Boat traffic. Sunset colors incredible.

attractions.name: Marché Central
attractions.tip: Chaotic market. Fabric sections colorful. Bargain hard.

attractions.name: Kin Malebo
attractions.tip: Waterfront area. Nightlife hub. Music scenes.

weather: Tropical. Wet/Dry seasons. Humid. Thunderstorms common.
airport: N'djili (FIH). Security tight. Arrange pickup in advance.
permits: Fixer highly recommended. Police checkpoints common. Avoid political topics.

intro: Africa's giant. Energetic, loud, creative. Traffic is legendary. Humidity fogs lenses instantly.

attractions.name: Lekki Conservation Centre
attractions.tip: Canopy walkway. Monkeys. Nature in the city.

attractions.name: Nike Art Gallery
attractions.tip: 5 floors of art. Owner welcomes filmmakers.

attractions.name: Third Mainland Bridge
attractions.tip: Longest in Africa. Shoot from boat below for safety.

weather: Hot/Humid. Two rainy seasons. Mold is a risk for gear.
airport: Murtala Muhammed (LOS). Traffic to exit airport is bad. Helicopter option exists.
permits: State film permit required. Police escorts often needed for location shoots.

intro: One of the world's most expensive cities. Oil wealth vs poverty. Logistics are hard; bring everything you need.

attractions.name: Marginal de Luanda
attractions.tip: Waterfront promenade. Sunset views. Locals gather here.

attractions.name: Fortaleza de São Miguel
attractions.tip: Old fort. Museum inside. History of slavery.

attractions.name: Ilha do Cabo
attractions.tip: Peninsula with clubs/restaurants. Vibe spot.

weather: Dry season May-Oct (best). Rainy Nov-Apr. Foggy mornings.
airport: Quatro de Fevereiro (LAD). New airport opening soon. Expensive transfers.
permits: Visa difficult. Press accreditation needed for professional work.

intro: Concrete jungle. Endless skyline. Safety varies by block. Helicopter shots are common for a reason.

attractions.name: Avenida Paulista
attractions.tip: Main avenue. Sunday closed to cars. Museums lined up.

attractions.name: Mercado Municipal
attractions.tip: Stained glass. Mortadella sandwiches. High ceilings.

attractions.name: Beco do Batman
attractions.tip: Graffiti alley. Instagram gold. Safe during day.

weather: Subtropical. Four seasons in one day. Rain sudden.
airport: Guarulhos (GRU). Far away. Congonhas (CGH) closer for domestic.
permits: Favela filming dangerous without guide. General city ok but stay alert.

intro: High altitude (2250m). Ancient Aztec ruins under modern streets. Incredible food scene. Sirens are constant.

attractions.name: Zócalo
attractions.tip: Huge main square. Cathedral. Flag ceremony.

attractions.name: Teotihuacan
attractions.tip: Pyramids nearby. Climb Sun Pyramid. Hot/dusty.

attractions.name: Xochimilco
attractions.tip: Floating gardens. Trajinera boats. Party atmosphere.

weather: Spring-like year-round. Rainy summer afternoons. UV high due to altitude.
airport: Benito Juárez (MEX). Close to city. Uber safe. Metro busy.
permits: Drone laws strict. Archaeological sites have fees/rules.

intro: Paris of South America. Dinner at 10 PM. Tango culture. Economic volatility affects prices daily.

attractions.name: La Boca
attractions.tip: Colorful houses. Touristy but photogenic. Don't wander off main streets.

attractions.name: Recoleta Cemetery
attractions.tip: Evita's grave. Mausoleums intricate. Quiet respect needed.

attractions.name: Puerto Madero
attractions.tip: Modern docks. Skyscrapers. Bridges lit up at night.

weather: Four distinct seasons. Hot humid summers. Cool winters.
airport: Ezeiza (EZE). Far out. Minibus transfer recommended. Aeroparque for regional.
permits: Generally friendly to filmmakers. Tango shows may restrict pro gear.

intro: Stunning beauty between mountain and sea. Favelas on hillsides. Safety is paramount; don't flash gear.

attractions.name: Christ the Redeemer
attractions.tip: Iconic. Train or van up. Clouds often block view.

attractions.name: Copacabana/Ipanema
attractions.tip: Beach culture. Volleyball. Sunset drinks.

attractions.name: Selarón Steps
attractions.tip: Colorful tiles. Crowded. Pickpockets active.

weather: Tropical. Hot year-round. Rainy summer (Dec-Mar).
airport: Galeão (GIG). Scenic drive to city. Santos Dumont (SDU) closer.
permits: Favela tours only with trusted guides. Beach filming ok, drones restricted.

intro: High in the Andes. Cool climate. Graffiti art capital. Traffic is heavy; TransMilenio bus system is useful.

attractions.name: La Candelaria
attractions.tip: Old town. Colonial architecture. Cobblestones.

attractions.name: Monserrate
attractions.tip: Mountain overlooking city. Cable car or funicular. View is amazing.

attractions.name: Plaza de Bolívar
attractions.tip: Main square. Cathedral. Government buildings.

weather: Cool/Cold. Rainy Apr/May & Oct/Nov. Sun strong due to altitude.
airport: El Dorado (BOG). Modern. Close to city. Uber available.
permits: Graffiti tours popular. Some areas unsafe at night. Drone permit needed.

intro: Gastronomy capital. Coastal desert. Winter fog blankets the city for months. Ancient ruins everywhere.

attractions.name: Miraflores
attractions.tip: Cliffside parks. Paragliders. Modern malls.

attractions.name: Barranco
attractions.tip: Bohemian district. Bridge of Sighs. Street art.

attractions.name: Huaca Pucllana
attractions.tip: Pyramid in middle of city. Night tours available.

weather: Desert climate. Humid winter (Jun-Sep) with fog. Sunny summer.
airport: Jorge Chávez (LIM). New expansion. Traffic to Miraflores heavy.
permits: Archaeological sites have rules. Drone ban near airports/sites.

intro: Nestled in a valley with snowy peaks. Smog traps in winter. Modern metro system. Very safe compared to neighbors.

attractions.name: Cerro San Cristóbal
attractions.tip: Statue of Virgin. Cable car. Panoramic views.

attractions.name: Lastarria
attractions.tip: Cultural neighborhood. Cafes. Cinema.

attractions.name: Mercado Central
attractions.tip: Iron structure. Seafood. Historic.

weather: Mediterranean. Hot dry summers. Cool wet winters. Smog alerts common.
airport: Arturo Merino (SCL). Efficient. Metro connects to city.
permits: Generally easy. Mountain areas may need CONAF permit.
